plans.close_all: Close any layer that breaches 50% of its RP; flatten all if total NAV(-) reaches 35% of notional.
plans.hostage_policy: Run max 2 simultaneous layers. If one is NAV(-), use the second to harvest volatility until the first is released. Do not add to losers.
